description.value: Bon Cafe is a neighbourhood Vietnamese restaurant in Vancouver's Little Mountain area, a short ride from Queen Elizabeth Park at the corner of Main Street and E. 33rd Ave. The menu centres on pho, banh mi, and Vietnamese coffee, with reviewers consistently praising generous portions and solid value. Both dine-in and takeout are available, making it a practical pit-stop on the Main Street cycling corridor.

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 32m; stands (3 spaces, covered) at 51m; stands (2 spaces) at 62m; stands (2 spaces) at 75m. Total: 9 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content at boncafepho.com is fully accessible and corroborates all OSM contact details (phone, address, website). The site confirms dine-in and takeout service, Vietnamese cuisine including pho and banh mi, and locates the cafe near Queen Elizabeth Park. No bike-specific amenities (racks, washrooms, Wi-Fi, charging) are mentioned anywhere on the site or in OSM tags.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The cafe is a legitimate, active food stop on a busy cycling corridor near Queen Elizabeth Park, but none of the three required WWC criteria (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) could be confirmed from available evidence. A quick on-site check to verify at minimum a usable bike parking spot and washroom access would allow a confident include.
enrichment_extras.notes: Contact page notes 'The Main Street and 33rd Buses stop in front and beside our cafe' and 'Easy access with free street parking' — transit-friendly location but no cyclist-specific infrastructure mentioned. Recommend in-person or outreach verification for bike parking and washrooms before final listing.

wow_evidence: neighbourhood Vietnamese restaurant in Vancouver's Little Mountain area

price.label: Cheap eats
price.signal: Pho shop, 'no frills,' 'great value' emphasized throughout reviews
